europe_now.title: EU issues ultimatum to Turkey over waste treatment standards
europe_now.summary: The European Union has issued a strict warning to Turkey regarding its waste management practices. Failure to comply with required waste treatment standards could result in a trade ban.

sources.headline: EU warns Turkey to clean up waste treatment or face trade ban

europe_now.title: Romanian president nominates MEP Siegfried Mureșan to form government
europe_now.summary: Amid ongoing political turmoil in Romania, the president has tapped European lawmaker Siegfried Mureșan to lead the country out of its current crisis. The nomination aims to stabilize political leadership through experienced EU-level representation.

sources.headline: Romanian president taps EU lawmaker Mureșan to lead country out of crisis

top_stories.title: EU Budget Discussions and Divergences
top_stories.summary: Germany and Spain have entered a direct dispute over the upcoming European Union budget allocations. Meanwhile, several European leaders have emphasized that the bloc needs to focus on spending funds more effectively rather than simply increasing overall expenditures.

sources.headline: Germany and Spain go head-to-head in EU budget fight
Five EU leaders: Europe must spend better, not just more

top_stories.title: US Military Footprint and Security in Poland
top_stories.summary: Former US President Donald Trump announced that significant progress has been achieved toward establishing a permanent US military base in Poland. The development follows ongoing discussions regarding regional security enhancements along Europe's eastern flank.
